excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.4
excerpts.paraphrase: The 2026/27 edition of the Laws of the Game applies from 1 July 2026.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.47, Law 1 s.3
excerpts.paraphrase: Law 1 sets the touchline length between a minimum of 90 m and a maximum of 120 m.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.47, Law 1 s.3
excerpts.paraphrase: Law 1 sets the goal-line length between a minimum of 45 m and a maximum of 90 m.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.47, Law 1 s.3
excerpts.paraphrase: Whatever size is chosen, the touchline must be longer than the goal line, so a Law 1 pitch is never square.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.47, Law 1 s.3
excerpts.paraphrase: Competitions choose the exact length and width inside the Law range; the Law itself fixes no single size.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.47, Law 1 s.4
excerpts.paraphrase: For international matches the touchline must be between 100 m and 110 m.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.47, Law 1 s.4
excerpts.paraphrase: For international matches the goal line must be between 64 m and 75 m.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.47, Law 1 s.2
excerpts.paraphrase: All pitch lines share one width, and it may not exceed 12 cm.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.45, Law 1 s.2
excerpts.paraphrase: A line belongs to the area it bounds, so a ball touching the line is inside that area.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.45, Law 1 s.2
excerpts.paraphrase: Only Law 1 lines may be marked; on artificial surfaces other lines must be a clearly different colour.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.45, Law 1 s.2
excerpts.paraphrase: The halfway line joins the midpoints of the two touchlines and splits the pitch into halves.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.45, Law 1 s.2
excerpts.paraphrase: A circle of radius 9.15 m is marked around the centre mark at the midpoint of the halfway line.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.48, Law 1 s.5
excerpts.paraphrase: The goal area is drawn 5.5 m out from the inside of each goalpost and extends 5.5 m into the field.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.48, Law 1 s.6
excerpts.paraphrase: The penalty area is drawn 16.5 m out from the inside of each goalpost and extends 16.5 m into the field.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.48, Law 1 s.6
excerpts.paraphrase: The penalty mark sits 11 m from the midpoint between the goalposts.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.48, Law 1 s.6
excerpts.paraphrase: An arc of radius 9.15 m around each penalty mark is drawn outside the penalty area.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.48, Law 1 s.7
excerpts.paraphrase: The corner area is a quarter circle of radius 1 m around each corner flagpost, inside the field.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.49, Law 1 s.8
excerpts.paraphrase: Each corner needs a flagpost at least 1.5 m high with a non-pointed top and a flag.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.47, Law 1 s.2
excerpts.paraphrase: Optional marks may be made off the field 9.15 m from the corner arc, at right angles to the goal lines and touchlines.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.49, Law 1 s.9
excerpts.paraphrase: Where a seated area exists, the technical area extends 1 m either side of it and up to 1 m from the touchline.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.50, Law 1 s.10
excerpts.paraphrase: The goal is 7.32 m wide inside the posts and 2.44 m high from the ground to the crossbar's lower edge.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.50, Law 1 s.10
excerpts.paraphrase: Goalposts and crossbar are white, share one width and depth, and may not exceed 12 cm.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.46, Law 1 diagram notes
excerpts.paraphrase: Law 1 measurements run from the outside edge of the lines, because lines belong to the areas they enclose.

excerpts.locator: IFAB Laws of the Game 2026/27 PDF p.46, Law 1 diagram notes
excerpts.paraphrase: The 11 m to the penalty mark is measured from the centre of the mark to the back edge of the goal line.
